This sounds like an incredibly distressing and serious situation. If a child is being medicated inappropriately or harmed, that's a child safety issue that warrants immediate attention from the proper authorities. Consider contacting Child Protective Services or local law enforcement to report your concerns, as they can investigate potential child endangerment or medical abuse. You may also want to consult with a family law attorney who can help address the custody interference and guide you through legal protections.

If you need support navigating this, you can also reach out to the Childhelp National Child Abuse Hotline at 1-800-422-4453 for guidance on reporting and resources. Please prioritize the child's safety and take steps to involve professionals who can intervene appropriately.
